from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path=progdir/'task-acaf4ce1.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a complete, uniform divider separating two equal-sized panels.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i+r+1][j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    for c in range(w):
        val = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[i][c] == val for i in range(h)) and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i][j+c+1] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No centered full divider separating equal panels")
'''
path.write_text(source)
